title: Closet Cost-Per-Wear Wardrobe Value
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wardrobe:item
| stats sum(price) as value, count as items by category
| sort - value
description: Totals what your wardrobe is worth by category, a revealing (sometimes alarming) inventory.
value: Seeing the total value tied up in clothes informs insurance, decluttering, and future buying decisions.
implementation: Ingest wardrobe inventory into `index=personal`; total value by category.
visualization: Bar chart of wardrobe value by category.
grandmaExplanation: It totals what all your clothes are worth by type, a revealing look at your wardrobe.
